### Product Details

### About This Product

With a clean, streamlined tank and cover to complement today's bathroom, this dependable, clog-free toilet comes. A soft-close seat and an extra-sturdy lid, enhanced for stability and flex-free comfort, plus a white trip lever for a stylish and decorative touch. At 1.28 GPF, this WaterSense-approved model has plenty of flush power and it's easy to install with just 2 pieces that include a soft closing toilet seat, wax ring, and floor mounting bolt seat.

### Highlights

- High-efficiency, ultra-low consumption uses 1.28 gpf for significant water savings
- 17.5" tall toilet bowl is ADA compliant, gives your legs the extra room for added comfort
- Soft Close lid and seat prevent slamming
- 360°Jet siphon flushing technology offers virtually plug-free performance and rinsing power for a clean bowl
- Instant release hinges for easy removal and cleaning
- Highly aesthetic design with durable seat and decorative trip lever
- Round-front bowl offers an ideal solution for smaller baths and powder rooms
- WaterSense and UPC certified
- Toilet includes everything needed for installation: tank, bowl, trip-lever, seat with lid, speed connect tank-to-bowl coupling kit, bolt caps and wax ring
- Standard 12 in. (305 mm.) rough-in
